_readme: Editable model blurbs injected into email templates via {{.ModelCards.<section>}}. Cards only render when the id exists in config.yaml (by id or alias), and pricing/context is pulled live from the catalog — so emails never name stale models. Add/remove/reorder entries freely.

reasoning.name: GPT-5.6 Sol
reasoning.note: The raw-intelligence pick. OpenAI's deepest reasoner — strongest on hard math, science and multi-step agentic work. Escalate here when correctness beats cost.
reasoning.settings: reasoning_effort: high · leave temperature at default — reasoning models manage their own sampling

reasoning.name: GPT-5.6 Terra
reasoning.note: The balanced flagship: same 1M context as Sol at 40% of the price. The right default for production reasoning workloads.
reasoning.settings: reasoning_effort: medium is the sweet spot for most tasks

reasoning.name: Claude Fable 5
reasoning.note: Anthropic's frontier model. Exceptional sustained agentic coding, careful long-document analysis, and honest uncertainty handling — thinks before it answers with extended thinking.
reasoning.settings: extended thinking with a thinking budget; temperature 1.0 while thinking is enabled

reasoning.name: Claude Opus 4.8
reasoning.note: The dependable agentic-coding workhorse. Slightly behind Fable on raw reasoning, identical pricing, battle-tested on long tool-use loops.
reasoning.settings: temperature 0–0.3 for code, 1.0 with extended thinking for hard problems

reasoning.name: Kimi K3
reasoning.note: The open-weights frontier. Moonshot's 1M-context reasoner with vision and strong agentic tool use — frontier-class results with open weights.

reasoning.name: DeepSeek V4 Pro
reasoning.note: Cost-efficient deep reasoning: 1M context and up to 384K output tokens at a fraction of frontier pricing. The best $/reasoning-token on the menu.
reasoning.settings: temperature 0.6 for reasoning, 0 for extraction · avoid setting top_p and temperature together

reasoning.name: Gemini 3.5 Flash
reasoning.note: The cost-efficiency king with thinking enabled. 1M context, very fast time-to-first-token — ideal for high-volume pipelines that still need real reasoning.
reasoning.settings: thinking budget auto · temperature 0.7 default, 0 for classification

reasoning.name: Grok 4.5
reasoning.note: xAI's fast frontier reasoner with 500K context. Strong on current-events reasoning and willing to take positions other models hedge on.
reasoning.settings: temperature 0.7 default · pair with search tools for live data
